about: Adversary library for the blind-goal adversarial path (rehearsal/11-blind-goal-adversarial-path.md). Each pattern is a known-bad shape read from a source; its signature is the fact values that make it bad. A step's facts are scored against every pattern; a step that matches a whole signature fails. Fact fields only: names and labels are never inputs. SYNTHETIC. Design and education, not legal or tax advice.

keystone_claims.KS-4941: No step moves the foundation's money or property to a disqualified person, or lets one use it, directly or through someone who passes it on, except pay for program work the person actually did, at no more than the market rate, and repayment of a loan the person made to the foundation without interest. (formal/keystone, from 26 USC 4941)
